main.title: Hi! 👋
main.description: I'm Eduardo, a frontend developer. These days I focus on building mobile apps with React Native, in an international team and taking them all the way to production. Before that I worked on websites, desktop apps and blockchain, and I still build side projects in my spare time.
projects.title: Projects
projects.1.title: Website for a volleyball team
projects.1.description.1: I built this website for my volleyball team. It shows the standings of our league, the matches played and the ones still to come.
projects.1.description.2: It's built with Astro and React in TypeScript. A Node.js server downloads new photos from the team's Instagram and shrinks them. The site also shows the live scoreboard from our Twitch streams.
projects.2.title: Desktop app to read a sensor in real time
projects.2.description.1: A friend and I did this freelance project: reading a sensor and calculating minimums in real time. I built the desktop app, which connects over wifi to an ESP32 microcontroller programmed by my partner. It was my first time with Rust, and Tauri won me over. The challenge was drawing thousands of points on charts without the app slowing down.
projects.3.title: Mobile app to control a volleyball scoreboard
projects.3.description.1: Two teammates and I built a physical scoreboard and an online one for our Twitch streams. I made the mobile app that controls them and a small Node.js server that both scoreboards connect to. It turned out great.
projects.4.title: React Native app with sounds and music for board games
projects.4.description.1: Dicebeats adds sound effects to your role-playing and board game sessions. A song is playing and you want rain? Pick both sounds. The characters board a ship? Add the sound of the tide.
experience.title: Experience
experience.1.title: Interface to read a medical sensor
experience.1.description: I built a desktop app with Tauri (React + Rust) that displays a sensor's readings and processes its data. I worked alongside another programmer, who handled the microcontroller. I made sure the interface felt smooth and pleasant to use.
experience.2.title: Private blockchain to measure stakers' contribution
experience.2.description: I worked on a private blockchain based on Tendermint. I wrote smart contracts to track stakers' participation in the network. I also used the project for my final degree thesis, on online voting with blockchain.
experience.3.title: 2nd place at the EthOdyssey hackathon
experience.3.description: I presented the work from my university internship and placed second in the NuCypher category.
experience.4.title: Company internship
experience.4.description: I learned the blockchain ecosystem and Web3 architecture, and developed smart contracts in Solidity.
experience.5.title: Specialist Software Engineer
experience.5.description: I build React Native microfrontends for a service embedded in Vodafone's apps, used by thousands of people across several countries. I also handle the native integration with the two host apps: Kotlin on Android and Swift on iOS. I work in an international team and have taken part in the full cycle, from development to production.
